run_litellm_proxy: run the LiteLLM proxy server on a specified host and port with optional config file and SSL support
test_litellm_proxy_chat: test the LiteLLM proxy by sending a chat completion request and verify the response
check_litellm_proxy_health: check the health of the LiteLLM proxy by hitting the /health endpoint
run_litellm_proxy_gunicorn: run the LiteLLM proxy server via gunicorn with multiple workers for production deployments
print_litellm_version: print the current installed version of the LiteLLM package
